No document says what any state means."},"model":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"XM-8102 data sheet (telco.com 2026-08); the faceplate prints X-METRO 8102."},"ports":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"The 24 SFP+ ports are two stacked 2 x 6 blocks, std/sfp-ganged@1, upper row bail up and lower row turned 180, on the measured 14.45 and 14.61 pitches (columns 19.55-91.8 and 117.3-190.35, rows 14.15 and 32.15); the strip between the rows carries two arrow lamps per port, down-up-down-up, at the XM-8424H's and TM-3312's offsets from the column centre (-4.75, -1.9, +1.8, +4.65; measured here -4.55, -1.55, +1.95, +4.75 - within 0.35 mm, about 1.2 px of the source render). Each column is legended with one pair, 2/1 to 24/23; the upper cage is drawn as the first number (see the port-order gap). THE NUMERALS ARE PLACED WHERE PRINTED, measured by clustering their glyphs: they run on a 14.29 and a 14.44 pitch against the cages' 14.45 and 14.61, so they sit 1.85 mm right of the first column and drift to 0.1 mm right of the last, and L61 stays in the baseline for them on purpose. A column of five vent dots stands at the left of each block. QSFP 1 and 2 are a 1 x 2 row (std/qsfp-ganged@1 at 231.25 and 261.35) under a bracketed \"40GE/100GE\" legend."},"power":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"\"2 hot-swappable AC/DC power supplies provide 1+1 redundancy\", \"AC:220V, 100~240VAC | DC: -48V, -36~-72V\".
